page.overview:
Who is Athodan?

was an arcane researcher of the flying city of Aeor, who became famous among his people after finding a strange relic whose properties were used in necromantic and rejuvenation experiments.

His first tests involving the powers of his discovery involved reversing the aging process of overripe fruit, and although the results were messy (the fruit ended up liquefied and tossed all over), led to the accidental creation of a tasty drink that other Aeorians recreated to celebrate and taunt the researcher at various celebrations. Athodan, however, continued his experiments, and eventually he collaborated with Archmage Ayoshadaf, using the artifact to develop a form of time travel, allowing someone to travel to the past while leaving a shadow of themselves anchored in the present. Athodan was in a privileged enough position to have an area of the Genesis Ward dedicated solely to his team and his project, and was only accessible by using a bracelet.
